name: Compert
text: Compert is an Irish word meaning conception, the act of begetting or procreation. It names a whole genre of tales about how heroes were begotten and born. The plural form is Coimperta. Combert is a variant spelling of the same term. Stories of this kind open the lives of figures such as Cúchulainn, whose birth required divine intervention and mortal fosterage. See Combert for the sibling form.

attributes.attribute: Irish genre term for tales of heroic conception and birth

okr.objective: Compert is the Irish tale-genre of heroic conceptions and births.
key_results: Compert means conception, begetting, or procreation.
The plural Coimperta covers the collected birth-tales of heroes.
Combert is a variant spelling of the term.
